steps.name: verify actual donation without writes
do: assert(quest:GetStateBool('DoneIntro')); assert(quest:GetStateInt('BooksInGame')==40); assert(quest:GetStateInt('BooksDonated')==1); assert(quest:GetStateInt('GoodBooksDonated')==1); assert(not quest:GetStateBool('ReadingBook')); assert(not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,0),quest:GetHero()), 'donated book still in inventory'); for _,name in ipairs({'BookDonated','BookOwned'}) do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorCount(name)==40); for i=0,39 do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt(name,i)==(i==0),name..'['..i..']') end end; Runner.donationLoaded=true

steps.name: donate book one after fresh reload
do: local key=quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,1); assert(key~=''); if not quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt('BookDonated',1) and not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(key,quest:GetHero()) then quest:GiveHeroObject(key,1) end; assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt('BookDonated',1) or quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(key,quest:GetHero()),'second book grant not observed')
steps.until: quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt('BookDonated',1) and quest:GetStateInt('BooksDonated')==2 and not quest:GetStateBool('ReadingBook') and not quest:IsInCutscene() and not quest:IsInMovieSequence() and not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,1),quest:GetHero())

steps.name: verify and save two actual donations
do: assert(quest:GetStateBool('DoneIntro')); assert(quest:GetStateInt('BooksInGame')==40); assert(quest:GetStateInt('BooksDonated')==2); assert(quest:GetStateInt('GoodBooksDonated')==2); assert(not quest:GetStateBool('ReadingBook')); assert(not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,0),quest:GetHero()), 'donated book still in inventory'); for _,name in ipairs({'BookDonated','BookOwned'}) do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorCount(name)==40); for i=0,39 do assert(quest:GetStateFlagVectorAt(name,i)==(i<2),name..'['..i..']') end end; assert(not quest:IsObjectInThingsPossession(quest:ReadGlobalGameDataStringAt(0x4d4,1),quest:GetHero()),'second donated book still in inventory'); quest:AutoSave(); Runner.secondDonationSaved=true
